name: Tomato Herb Vinaigrette
intro: One jar. A week of flavor.
card_uses: Spoon it over the tomato plate.
Let white beans sit in it.
ingredients: Optional: 1 small garlic clove, finely grated
method: Combine the tomato, olive oil, sherry vinegar, salt, and optional garlic in a bowl. Stir once. Taste and adjust — more vinegar if it needs brightness, more oil if it needs body. Leave it rough. Tear in basil when you use it.

storage.note: Refrigerate promptly. Add fresh basil when serving.

uses.label: Tomato plate
uses.context: Keep the tomato chunks visible. It's the bright flavor.

uses.label: Rice bowl
uses.context: Over sliced steak or salmon, with cucumber.

uses.label: Wild salmon
uses.context: Stir in a little more olive oil so it drizzles rather than sits.

uses.label: Tomato toast
uses.context: Spoon it on thick, with burrata or an egg.

uses.label: Black beans
uses.context: Spoon over beans and give them a few minutes. They absorb the vinegar and oil.
